title: Behavioral Health Continuity Days on a Transition Fill
content:
A newly enrolled Pharmacy Benefit member in active behavioral health treatment receives additional days on the one transition fill of a non-formulary drug.

**Clause.** The behavioral health continuity days are ten (10) where the member has two or more paid behavioral health visit claims with a service date in the last two months, five (5) where the member has exactly one, and nothing where the member has none.

The claims read are claims booked on the member's Medicaid Managed Care Membership whose service category is behavioral health visit and whose adjudication status is paid, with a service date in the last two months. The continuity days are added to the transition fill days.

### Table

| Paid behavioral health visit claims, last two months | Continuity days |
|---|---|
| Two or more | 10 |
| Exactly one | 5 |
| None | Nothing |

### Cases (hypothetical)

- Two paid behavioral health visits five and seven weeks ago: 10 days.
- One paid visit and one denied visit: only the paid one counts, 5 days.
- A paid visit three months ago only: outside the two months, nothing.
